pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'la santé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. vegetables
   B. health
   C. the mango
   D. milk

2. What does 'près de' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. near
   B. straight ahead
   C. to the left
   D. to the right

3. What does 'Où est la clé ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The rug is under the table.
   B. Where is the key?
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. The TV is on the table.

4. Which little word goes with 'neige' (the snow)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

5. How do you say 'Mrs, Madam' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Madame
   B. non
   C. merci
   D. Monsieur

6. What does 'Oui, ça va.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yes, I am fine.
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. Goodbye, Sir.
   D. Good evening, Madam!

7. Which little word goes with 'poulet' (the chicken)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

8. What does 'aujourd'hui' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. today
   B. I play
   C. I dance
   D. I rest

9. How do you say 'yes' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Enchanté
   B. bonsoir
   C. oui
   D. Madame

10. Fill in: Cher Kamau, ______ anniversaire ! (1 mark)
   A. Bonsoir
   B. Bonne
   C. Bon
   D. Salut

11. Fill in: ______ frère s'appelle Kamau. (1 mark)
   A. Mon
   B. Une
   C. La
   D. Ma

12. Which little word goes with 'banane' (the banana)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

13. What does 'sous' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. on
   B. between
   C. under
   D. in

14. How do you say 'today' in French? (1 mark)
   A. hier
   B. je me repose
   C. demain
   D. aujourd'hui

15. What does 'une inondation' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the snow
   B. the storm
   C. a flood
   D. the weather

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the months from juillet to décembre in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Translate into English: 'C'est une banane.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'I like the mango.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'The rug is under the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Translate into English: 'C'est une table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — health
   la santé means health.

2. A — near
   près de means near.

3. B — Where is the key?
   Où est la clé ? means Where is the key?

4. B — la
   neige is feminine, so we say la neige.

5. A — Madame
   Mrs, Madam in French is Madame.

6. A — Yes, I am fine.
   Oui, ça va. means Yes, I am fine.

7. C — le
   poulet is masculine, so we say le poulet.

8. A — today
   aujourd'hui means today.

9. C — oui
   yes in French is oui.

10. C — Bon
   Bon anniversaire is the wish.

11. A — Mon
   Frère is masculine, so we say mon.

12. C — la
   banane is feminine, so we say la banane.

13. C — under
   sous means under.

14. D — aujourd'hui
   today in French is aujourd'hui.

15. C — a flood
   une inondation means a flood.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: juillet, août, septembre, octobre, novembre, décembre
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all correct; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a banana.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'aime la mangue.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le tapis est sous la table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: When is your birthday?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
